_comment: Exact tool versions for the oga-re toolchain. Reproducibility matters: a finding recorded against one decompiler version is not automatically valid against another, and Ghidra extensions are version-locked (see ghidraCompatibility). Verified by `scoop info <pkg>` against the live manifests plus each project's official release page.

python.note: Pre-installed by the user. Must NOT be downgraded. Ghidra 12.1.3 officially supports Python 3.9-3.14 for PyGhidra, so 3.14 is in range.

ghidraJdkRequirement.authority: Ghidra 12.1.3 GettingStarted.md: 'Java 21 64-bit Runtime and Development Kit (JDK)'; WhatsNew.md: 'Ghidra 12.1 requires, at minimum, JDK 21 to run'.
ghidraJdkRequirement.note: Ghidra 11.2 (Sept 2024) raised the floor from JDK 17 to JDK 21, so JDK 17 no longer suffices for ANY current Ghidra. Scoop's extras/ghidra manifest itself says: 'Ghidra requires JDK 21 on the PATH to run'. Do not substitute temurin17-jdk. The master-branch docs mentioning JDK 25 are unreleased dev docs.

packages.purpose: source control; needed to fetch decompilation projects and emulator sources
unpacking Ghidra release zips and decomp archives

packages.match: one respin behind upstream; functionally equivalent
packages.purpose: REQUIRED by Ghidra. Manifest sets JAVA_HOME and PATH, which is what Ghidra looks for.

packages.conflict: 12.1.3 CANNOT run dsd-ghidra (built for 11.2.1 only). See ghidraCompatibility. For the FE11 symbol-sync workflow, Ghidra 11.2.1 must be installed MANUALLY from GitHub releases — scoop does not carry it (the versions bucket has only ghidra92, which is obsolete).

packages.purpose: building ds-decomp/dsd from source (prebuilt Windows .exe exists, so not needed for dsd itself)
packages.note: MSVC toolchain. Needs Microsoft C++ Build Tools + Windows SDK to LINK. Use `rustup-msvc` (1.29.1) if rustup-managed toolchains/nightly are wanted. dsd source builds need Rust >= 1.85 (edition 2024).

packages.purpose: fe11-us and ds-decomp build with ninja, not make
some emulator builds (mGBA, melonDS) use CMake
GNU make. Verified as genuinely current: make-4.5.tar.gz on ftp.gnu.org returns HTTP 404.

installCommands: scoop bucket add java && scoop install temurin21-jdk
scoop bucket add extras && scoop install ghidra
scoop install rust ninja cmake make

ghidraCompatibility._whyThisSectionExists: Ghidra extensions are compiled against a specific Ghidra release, and the 11->12 jump broke pre-12 extensions hard. Two of the FE11 tools require Ghidra versions that no single install can satisfy, so this is tracked rather than discovered later as a mysterious load failure.

dsd-ghidra v0.7.0.confidence: stated 4 ways: extension.properties version=11.2.1, CI setup-ghidra pin, release asset named ghidra_11.2.1_PUBLIC_..., README/gradle.properties.example paths

conflicts: dsd-ghidra (11.2.1) and NTRGhidra (12.0.4) are mutually exclusive at matched versions: no single Ghidra install satisfies both.
PyGhidra did not exist until Ghidra 11.3, so dsd-ghidra's target release (11.2.1) CANNOT run CPython Ghidra scripts headlessly at all.

Ghidra 12.0 upgraded internal jars, and pre-12 extension zips have failed to load outright with NoSuchMethodError in ExtensionUtils.createExtensionDetailsFromArchive (Ghidra issue #8976). Mismatched extensions DO install with a red highlight and a confirm prompt (issue #1193), but the warning is not cosmetic across a major version.
Ghidra project data does not go backwards: a project created or modified in 12.1 cannot be opened by 11.2.1.
ghidraCompatibility.resolution: Run TWO Ghidra installs side by side, never one reconciled install. Ghidra 11.2.1 for dsd-ghidra symbol sync (this is also what the community does — the DQIX decomp project pins exactly Ghidra_11.2.1_build + dsd-ghidra, and warns to pin the plugin version because a bad release broke their game). A separate Ghidra 12.x only if NTRGhidra's dynamic-overlay plugin or PyGhidra 3.x headless scripting is needed. Both may target the same .nds and the same config/YFEE01/arm9/config.yaml; only the project files must stay in their own version's format.
ghidraCompatibility.ifForcedToOne: Ghidra 11.2.1 + dsd-ghidra. Symbol synchronization with the decompilation project is the stated requirement, and dsd-ghidra is the only tool that provides it.

headless.warning: analyzeHeadless.bat does NOT enable PyGhidra mode in 12.1.3 — its README does not mention PyGhidra or Jython at all. `pyghidraRun.bat` is a separate launcher. Ghidra 12.0 also changed the default Python engine from Jython to PyGhidra, and 12.1 demoted Jython to an optional extension, so Jython scripts need an explicit `# @runtime Jython` header.
headless.blocker: dsd-ghidra's symbol sync is GUI-ONLY by construction — SyncDsd.java is a plain GhidraScript (not HeadlessScript), it unconditionally constructs a Swing DsdConfigChooser file dialog and calls getSelectedFile(), and a scan of every .java file for isRunningHeadless/HeadlessAnalyzer/HeadlessScript returns ZERO hits with no getScriptArgs() handling. Automating it requires writing a wrapper that bypasses DsdConfigChooser and calls the dsdghidra.sync.* classes directly. This is a real limitation for an agent-driven workflow and is tracked as such.
